protocol.pca_fit: all 7,623 records (7,025 unique compositions), inputs only, no labels
protocol.at_point_estimator: Nadaraya-Watson reported in-sample and leave-one-out (local_at_*_loo); the kNN estimator always excludes the point itself
protocol.grid_statistics: grid_frac_supported_below_0.9 is over supported cells only (kernel mass >= 3; grid_frac_supported gives their share); grid_frac_all_cells_below_0.9 is over all cells
protocol.evaluated_records: source-test + all target records (recal pool and target-test halves) + intermediate (0 < P < target threshold); source-train and source-cal excluded
protocol.grid: 90x90, 1-99th percentiles of PC1/PC2, cells with kernel mass < 3.0 empty
